question: Electric current in a circuit is measured by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ammeter.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **ammeter** is an instrument used to measure the **flow of electric current** in a circuit.
 
• It is connected in** series** with the circuit, which means that the current flows through the ammeter.
 
• The unit of measurement of electric current is Amperes&
